blocks.name: Source and monitoring scope
blocks.description: Original data-only example by OpenCVDataflowGUI contributors (MIT). No customer data or images. Status is not a physical acceptance result. REAL-PROTOCOL TEMPLATE: monitoring disabled. Configure the intended endpoint and enable only when ready to make read-only probes. These documentation IPs are placeholders. ROS checks discovery, observer receipts and optional read-only empty GetParameters responses. FANUC needs a local Workbench profile. No outputs, parameters or motion are written.
